summary: Phase A (Alpha Omega Phi member portal) backend + frontend verified. 9/9 new Phase A pytest tests pass (test_phase_a.py). 48/50 across full backend suite (2 pre-existing photo/document file-proxy failures are due to /api/files/* now requiring auth — already noted as enhancement in iteration_2 and out of Phase A scope). Frontend smoke verified: AOP Forms rename, Home columns (new members & birthdays) with data, Hours dialog with new fields, Chapters region/state inputs, Admin new-member dialog with address/birthdate/branch/status, MemberCardDialog renders without password/security info.

minor.issue: Pre-existing — file proxy now returns 401 to unauthenticated requests, which is correct behavior but breaks old fraternity tests that fetched without auth. Out of Phase A scope.

issues: Date field uses native browser <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component — UX inconsistent with rest of app.
No visible 'Status' column header text in the table; status is rendered as a pill in each row. Functionally OK (pill shows ACTIVE/etc.), but a column header label would help scanability.

Only renders fields that have data, so for seed/test members without phone/birthdate/branch_of_service those rows are absent. Not a bug; mentioning so main agent knows the spec items 'phone, birthdate, branch_of_service, chapter' only show when populated.

action_items: Optional: replace native date input in Hours LogHoursDialog with shadcn DatePicker for consistency.
Optional: add visible 'Status' column header in Admin Members table.
Pre-existing: gate /api/files/{path} consistently OR adjust test_fraternity.py to authenticate the file fetch (currently expects 200 without cookies — already 401 with current auth gate).
critical_code_review_comments: chapter_out still echoes legacy school/city even when only region/state are used; harmless but extra payload.
set_member_status: when body.status is None but body.deceased_at is supplied, code sets only deceased_at — that's fine, but worth double-checking semantics with main agent.
/api/members-birthdays does an in-memory scan + per-doc parsing; acceptable today, may need indexed/agg-pipeline impl at scale (>1000 members).

AdminCreateMemberIn stores birthdate as plain str; no format validation. A malformed birthdate would still be saved and then break /members-birthdays parsing (which silently 'continue's). Consider validating YYYY-MM-DD at create/update time.

Admin update: switching status to 'active' clears deceased_at — but if admin intentionally sets deceased_at to keep historical record, it gets nulled. Behavior matches spec (test passes) so flagging only as design note.

success_rate.backend: 100% on Phase A scope (9/9). 96% overall (48/50; 2 pre-existing file-proxy 401s out of Phase A scope)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on Phase A scope — all required UI elements present and integrations working

seed_data_creation: Tests create temp chapters / members / awards / hours with TEST_ prefix and clean up at end of each test. Existing demo members (Test X Newbie, Test User with birthdates Jun 3/10/17) used as fixtures to validate /api/members-birthdays.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A is fully wired and tested. test_phase_a.py covers: chapter region/state CRUD, hours new fields (event_type/agency_name/host_*), admin member create/update with address/birthdate/branch_of_service/member_status, /members-birthdays + /members-new endpoints, award custom granted_at, set_member_status deceased<->active deceased_at flip. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set or sourced from env. Frontend home columns are gated behind authentication (rendered only when current user is set). Hours dialog uses native date picker — possible Phase B enhancement.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in Phase A. The 2 failing fraternity tests are pre-existing and reflect intentional auth tightening on /api/files/*; they were already noted as an enhancement in iteration_2.json and are not Phase A scope.
